video.description:
This video explains Spec-Driven Development and how it differs from vibe coding. It shows why vibe coding can lead to loss of control and inconsistent results, and how writing a detailed specification document helps guide AI coding tools more reliably. The video walks through the structure of a spec document, demonstrates a real example, explains technical design plans, and outlines the full workflow from specification to coding and validation. It also compares both approaches and discusses when each method should be used.
